access_indicators.classification: Three independent dimensions, never mutually exclusive. Distributed/Represented is not access metadata.
access_indicators.known_kyc: Issuer access requirement supported by issuer documentation; does not label every secondary trade as KYC-gated.
access_indicators.mint_redeem: Reported issuer subscription and redemption capability, with settlement timing and eligibility still source-bound. Not an executable Nest route.
access_indicators.dex: Two-sided public Stellar XLM orderbook observed for the exact classic asset code and issuer. Not an amount-specific quote or authorization check.
access_indicators.unknown: No verified evidence remains ?, not false/no. Empty XLM books do not exclude other markets or AMMs.

implementation_notes: Design preview uses embedded dated observations for deterministic local review; production should use typed same-origin services and query state.
No live provider fetch or financial submission occurs in these preview files.
Production sorting/filtering/pagination must use the actual backend contract, not client recomputation of execution terms.
The root application must retain the original solid-egg Nest logo, global Guardrails, and the shared ActionReviewSheet for any supported action.
